title: Redirect via redirect (php) — review required
description: The php call redirect redirects the user to a computed address. If the address derives from untrusted input, phishing links gain the site's credibility. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the target is fixed or validated.
remediation: Redirect only to fixed paths or validate the target with a same-origin check before redirecting.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any redirect call matches, including fixed-target redirects.
